Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(I):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    def uni(r): return len(set(r))==1
    cands=[]
    for i in range(H-1):
        a,b=i,i+1
        if len({I[k][0] for k in range(H) if k not in (a,b)})==1 and uni(I[a])!=uni(I[b]):
            cands.append(('v',i))
    for j in range(W-1):
        a,b=j,j+1
        ca=[I[k][a] for k in range(H)]; cb=[I[k][b] for k in range(H)]
        if len({I[i][j] for i in range(H) if i not in (a,b)})==1 and uni(ca)!=uni(cb):
            cands.append(('h',j))
    o,a=cands[0]; O=[r[:] for r in I]
    if o=='v':
        src=I[a] if a==0 else I[H-2]
        rev=src[::-1]
        k=b+1 if a==0 else a-1
        step=1 if a==0 else -1
        idx=0
        while 0<=k<H:
            O[k]=[rev[idx%len(rev)]]*W
            idx+=1; k+=step
    else:
        src=ca if a==0 else cb
        rev=src[::-1]
        k=b+1 if a==0 else b-1
        step=1 if a==0 else -1
        idx=0
        while 0<=k<W:
            for ii in range(H): O[ii][k]=rev[idx%len(rev)]
            idx+=1; k+=step
    return O

    o,ii,a_,b_=cands[0]
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    if o=='v':
        # source = non-uniform line of the pair

        ca=[I[k_][a_] for k_ in range(H)]; cb=[I[k_][j][0] for j in []]
        ca=[I[k_][j_][a_] for j_ in range(1)]  # placeholder
        ca=[I[k_][j] for k_ in range(H)]
        cb=[I[k_][j+1] for k_ in range(H)]
        src=ca if not uni(ca) else cb
        ua=j if uni(cb) else j+1       # uniform companion column index
        rev=src[::-1]
        d=-(ua-j-1) if False else (j-ua)  # direction away from uniform companion

# Verify the intended rule quickly against demos before resubmitting.
G=load()
def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    def ru(i): return len(set(I[i]))==1
    pairs=[]
    for i in range(H-1):
        if len(set(I[i]))!=len(set(I[i+1])): pairs.append(('row',i))
    o,pos=pairs[0]; O=[r[:] for r in I]
    if o=='row':
        src=[x for x in I[pos]] if not ru(pos) else [x for x in I[pos+1]]
        u = pos if ru(pos) else pos+1
        s = pos+1 if not ru(pos) else pos
        d = -1 if s>u else 1           # fill on far side of uniform from source
        start=(u-1) if d==-1 else (u+1)
        idx=(len(src)-1) if d==-1 else 0   # anchor at end nearest uniform; move AWAY (index decreases when walking up)
        while 0<=start<H:
            O[start]=[src[idx%len(src)] for _ in range(W)]
            idx+=d; start+=d
    return O
for n in [1,2]:
    print(n, solve(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
print('test input:')

def solve_pair(k):
    gi,go=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']
    Hh,Ww=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in gi]
    uni_rows=[r for r in range(Hh) if len(set(gi[r]))==1 and r not in (0,Hh-1)]
    if uni_rows:
        br=min(uni_rows)
        sr=max(r for r in range(Hh) if r!=br and len(set(gi[r]))>1)
        S=list(gi[sr]); N=len(S)
        fill_above = any(len(set(gi[r]))==1 and set(gi[r])!={g} for g in [])  # placeholder
        # determine fill side: rows above band that are uniform (same color across row)
        above=[set(gi[r]) for r in range(br)]
        below=[set(gi[r]) for r in range(br+1,Hh)]
        # fill side = side whose rows are uniform single-color blocks
        def side_is_fill(sides, lo, hi): return all(len(s)==1 for s in sides)
        if side_is_fill([set(gi[r]) for r in range(0,br)],0,br):
            for r in range(br-1,-1,-1):
                d=br-1-r
                out[r]=[S[(d-1)%N]]*Ww   # forward from S[0]? D1 says backward from S[-1]: S[(-d)%N]
        else:
            for r in range(br+1,Hh):
                d=r-br
                out[r]=[S[d%N]]*Ww
    else:
        bc=min(c for c in range(Ww) if len(set([gi[r][c] for r in range(Hh)]))==1 and c not in (0,Ww-1))
        sc=max(c for c in range(Ww) if c!=bc and len(set([gi[r][c] for r in range(Hh)]))>1)
        S=[gi[r][sc] for r in range(Hh)]; N=len(S)
        if sc<bc:  # fill right -> backward from S[-1]
            for c in range(bc+1,Ww):
                d=c-bc
                v=S[(-d)%N]
                for r in range(Hh): out[r][c]=v
        else:      # fill left -> forward from S[0]
            for c in range(0,bc):
                d=bc-c
                v=S[(d-1)%N]
                for r in range(Hh): out[r][c]=v
    return out
